decisiveEvidence.observation: X keyframe at t=8.60s (the anc.settle.shelter-certified anchor and habitat-core-online milestone) is a featureless brown box interior: the camera is inside or clipped against geometry. The X digest shows this state persisting across telemetry frames 2-8 (t=8.6s to 14.0s, contrast 0.05-0.09, maxLuma ~0.45), so both settle-beat anchors and the ch9:settled milestone at 11.0s land on an unreadable picture. The anchor is authored to a moment the image cannot show.

X opening at 6.90s has no primary subject: a sheep body crops the left edge, a deer face intrudes at the right edge, a small ring marker sits at centre in tall grass. The hearth opening at 21.50s and the t=110.50s frame are the same static composition with an unexplained blue-and-grey polygon slab crossing the foreground and floating slab blocks on the water; X telemetry for 21.5-110.5s holds luma within 0.51-0.53 with contrast pinned at 0.27, indicating a near-static camera for ~90 s while the hearth exit milestone is never reached.

Y carries a legible arrival: opening at 4.80s frames a green target cube centred in the cockpit window against a starfield; at 14.40s (objective landfall) the voxel planet fills the window; at 25.80s (anc.ch10.bearing-claimed, caption-first) the player is on the surface among palms and deer with a post marker as a foreground subject; at 61.10s the cockpit again with a drifting pod in the window. Y luma ramps 0.06 -> 0.22 -> 0.48 across the approach and drops 0.48 -> 0.30 at the transit-ignite anchor (30.20s), so the picture turns where the anchors sit. The seam-of-light anchor at 52.90s shows no measurable change (luma flat at ~0.07), so that one anchor is unconfirmed by the picture.

Y palette is one world: navy and cyan cockpit with a warm orange lever and warm console strips against the cool window, consistent across 4.80s, 14.40s and 61.10s. X mixes neon green grass, a saturated brown box (colorful 0.92 with contrast 0.05, reading as grey-orange mush) and stray blue polygons, so its settle-beat and hearth-beat frames do not read as the same world.

Smoothness: X captured no adjacent-frame bursts, so its flicker is unmeasured; its camera-inside-geometry span (8.6-14.0s) is a state-integrity defect regardless. Y has one burst at 30.60s with flickerRatio 2.6 and signFlips 0.75 but meanAdjDelta 0.0023 and changed=0.01, pops=0, blank 0/23: a measurable but sub-perceptual oscillation, flagged FLICKER by the producer and smooth by the second pass. Y's 25.8s -> 30.2s -> 36.7s luma steps (0.48 -> 0.30 -> 0.07) are scene changes rather than in-scene pops, but the beat boundary may snap; not confirmable from these frames.
